messages:
ticket-bot: New ticket #4890 created: https://redwood.tickets/4890 — Priority: P2 (sales)

Sam (Support): WidgetCo reported a regression: they need the assistant to stream completion tokens and also emit partial function-call payloads (JSON fragments) as tokens arrive. Their downstream system consumes fragments in real time.

Priya (Sales): They're asking us to guarantee that they won't have to buffer 1–3s waiting for the full function payload. This is a deal factor (~$120k ARR) if we can show a clear plan and ETA.

Alice (Product): Paste the exact text in the ticket and the failure mode. Also what is the absolute minimum we can ship that Sales can take to the customer? Need MVP acceptance criteria.

Sam (Support): From ticket: "We stream user input to the assistant and need the assistant to emit incremental JSON fields (partial args) for our order-matching service. Right now we wait for complete function call payloads — that causes spikes in latency and hurts UX. Ideally we get fragments like {"order_id": "...", "items": [ ... partial ... ] } while tokens stream."

Juan (Eng): Quick feasibility notes: runtime currently emits a unified function_call event only at finish. To emit intermediate fragments we can: 1) send separate progress events containing JSON deltas; or 2) extend the tokenizer/event stream to include `function_call_fragment` tokens. Option 2 touches multiple layers (model framing, SDKs, validation).

Maya (Eng-ML): ML caveats: models sometimes output broken JSON mid-stream (unclosed arrays/braces). We'll need client assembly guidance and an eval harness to exercise partial-output cases. Also some quantized models split tokens mid-codepoint — affects fragment boundaries.

Alice (Product): I propose three scoped options for negotiation with Sales/Customer:
- Option A (MVP, low lift): add a side-channel "progress_event" that streams JSON patch fragments every N tokens or T ms. No change to `function_call` contract.
- Option B (Medium): introduce `function_call_fragment` events in the main stream; clients can reassemble into the final call. Backwards compatible if gated.
- Option C (Planned): full partial-structured-output protocol with per-token schema hints, server-side fragment validation, and SDK helpers for zero-loss reassembly. Big effort.

Priya (Sales): WidgetCo's compliance team wants schema validation in real time, but they said they'd accept Option A if latency between fragments is acceptable (<300ms median). They prefer B long-term but won't wait months.

Juan (Eng): Rough estimates: Option A ~2 dev-weeks (runtime + small infra + SDK helper docs); Option B ~8–10 dev-weeks (runtime, SDKs, e2e tests); Option C 12+ weeks (validation infra + policies).

Maya (Eng-ML): Risks: malformed fragments, schema drift, increased KV-cache churn for long sessions. I'll add targeted tests: token-level fuzzing and partial-JSON regression set.

Alice (Product): Proposed MVP acceptance criteria (Option A):
- API: `progress_event` stream that can carry JSON fragment payloads alongside token stream.
- Performance: median inter-fragment latency < 300ms for typical order payloads; p95 < 900ms.
- Safety: docs showing safe reassembly patterns and example client code.
- Tests: integration test with WidgetCo sample, regression suite included in CI.
- Rollout: feature-flagged canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with rollback metric checks.

Sam (Support): I attached WidgetCo sample payloads to #4890 (small orders, chunked names/items). I'll keep them updated.

Priya (Sales): Can we aim for Option A in 3 weeks if we deprioritize a couple of infra chores? Customer wants a quarter commitment.

Juan (Eng): If PM locks scope, we can aim for a 3-week cycle for Option A. Need a dedicated eng pair and one SRE to plumb streaming events. Will open an RFC and a tracking ticket.

Maya (Eng-ML): I'll start the eval harness immediately. ETA for baseline tests: 5 business days.

Alice (Product): Decision: ship Option A as short-term commitment. Owners:
- Product: Alice — API contract, docs, acceptance criteria
- Eng: Juan — runtime + infra + RFC
- Eng-ML: Maya — evals + regression suite
- Support: Sam — customer verification + sample integration
- Sales: Priya — contract timeline & customer comms

Juan (Eng): I'll draft the RFC and include the feature-flag gating plan. Draft by EOD tomorrow.

Sam (Support): I'll confirm with WidgetCo that Option A is acceptable and log their signoff in #4890.

Priya (Sales): Thanks — I'll hold off contract signature until we have the RFC and a targeted delivery week. :thumbsup: 

Alice (Product): Action item: create product board card "incremental payload progress events (partial-structured-output)" -> link to ticket #4890. Sync meeting set for tomorrow 11am PT. I'll post RFC link here when ready. Closing thread for now.
